result.summary: Independently re-ran MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test (full suite, this worktree) myself rather than trusting Step 4's report: 4 properties, 500 tests, 0 failures, exit code 0 -- matches TEST-RUNNER's Step 4 numbers exactly, confirmed by my own invocation, not by reading their report. AC2 (byte-identical source/target -> empty-plan error, not empty entries list) -- promotion_plan.ex:152-153 (`if entries == [] -> {:error, :empty_plan}`) exercised by promotion_plan_test.exs:306-342 (asserts `result == {:error, :empty_plan}` at line 342). AC3 (production-tenant source -> invalid-promotion-source before any process_definitions read) -- promotion_plan.ex:129-134 (cond clause 2, `tenant_classifier.(source_tenant_id) == :production -> {:error, :invalid_promotion_source}`, fires before the `with` block at line 137 that performs the first DB read) exercised by promotion_plan_test.exs:352-371 (malformed target_tenant_id in the same call proves the classifier check short-circuited before any tenant-prefix resolution/DB read). AC4 (reject_if_conflicts/4: > base_version -> rejection detail naming the conflict; <=, including zero rows, -> no conflict) -- lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_conflict.ex conflict_for_pair/3 (lines 101-121) + version_greater?/2 (lines 127-135) exercised by test/letflow/definitions/promotion_conflict_test.exs:132-263 (covers >, ==, <, and zero-rows cases plus multi-pair variants). AC5 (compute_plan_digest/1 identical content, differently-ordered keys -> identical digest, explicit two-key-order test) -- lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_digest.ex canonicalize/1 (lines 87-94, sorts Map.keys/1 via Enum.sort/1 before rebuilding as Jason.OrderedObject) exercised by test/letflow/definitions/promotion_digest_test.exs:32-108 (two independent reordered-key examples, single-entry and multi-entry/deeply-nested). AC6 (verify_digest/2 constant-time comparison, stated in moduledoc) -- promotion_digest.ex:77-83 (`:crypto.hash_equals/2` in both verify_digest/2 clauses, no Kernel.==/2 or :erlang.=:=/2) and moduledoc lines 14-21 state this explicitly; exercised by promotion_digest_test.exs:159-215 including a test (208-214) that asserts the moduledoc text itself names :crypto.hash_equals/2. All 6 ACs hold. No staleness: docs/requirements.yaml REQ-036 reads status: in_progress (correct pre-DOC-UPDATER state) and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml's only REQ-036 event is the Step 00 'started' entry at 2026-08-17T18:01:34Z, consistent with in_progress. Spot-checked the run's own handoff chain for rubber-stamping: step-01b-code-design-validator.json, step-02c-security-reviewer.json, step-02d-reviewer.json, and step-03b-test-design-validator.json all show genuine independent verification -- specific file:line citations against real source files (role_registry.ex, tenant.ex, process_definition.ex), actual greps run and their results stated (e.g. zero Repo.insert/update/delete/update_all hits, zero GenServer/gen_statem/spawn hits, zero TODO/skip-tag hits), and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently re-ran the 3 new test files twice (plain and --seed 0) and got 33/33 both times before reporting PASS -- not one of the four echoes the producer's claim without its own check. No docs/migration/decisions/ record contradicted (Decision B schema-per-tenant :prefix strategy confirmed consistent by both SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER independently).
